name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: Native <dialog class="kl-dialog"> opened with showModal(): focus trap, Escape, backdrop and an inert page come from the browser. The dialog service builds alert/confirm/prompt dialogs as Promises.

attributes.name: closedby
attributes.description: 'any' also closes on a backdrop click (returnValue 'dismiss').

attributes.name: data-kl-dialog
attributes.description: Enables [data-kl-close] buttons and backdrop dismiss in every browser.

attributes.name: data-kl-dialog-open
attributes.description: The id of the dialog to open.

examples.title: Service
examples.js:
if (await dialog.confirm({ title: 'Send ₦45,000 to Ada Obi?', confirmText: 'Send' })) send();
const name = await dialog.prompt({ title: 'Rename card', label: 'Card name' });

examples.title: Markup
examples.html:

Send money

notes: On phones the dialog becomes a bottom sheet with stacked buttons.
